up: Retrieve all IC50 activity records for compound CHEMBL5498743 and its salt forms against target CHEMBL392. Include the following information for each record: compound ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, assay description, literature PubMed ID or DOI, and the IC50 value with its units and relation.
sql:
WITH target_mols AS (
  SELECT
    parent.molregno,
    parent.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
    parent.pref_name AS pref_name
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    child.molregno,
    child.chembl_id,
    child.pref_name
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743'
)
SELECT
  tm.chembl_id,
  tm.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.description AS assay_description,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation
FROM target_mols tm
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = tm.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = tm.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = ass.tid
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL392'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
